name: Promo — every feature in one video
cta_script: Type Better. Free to start, with two thousand AI words.

segments.label: Grammar
script: Grammar mistakes? One tap, and all of them are gone.

segments.label: Tone
script: Too blunt? Pick from twenty two tones, and it rewrites the message for you.

segments.label: Shorten
script: Rambling? One tap cuts it down to what you meant.

segments.label: Reply
script: Don't know what to say? It writes the reply for you.

segments.label: Continue
script: Start a sentence, and it finishes the thought.

segments.label: Voice
script: Or just talk. It cleans up what you said, and types it for you.
